sections.approach: 1) Transliterate the german sharp s (ß -> ss) since it has no unicode decomposition. 2) Apply unicode NFKD decomposition so accented letters split into base letter + combining mark. 3) Diacritic stripping: remove combining marks (U+0300-U+036F). 4) Lowercase conversion. 5) Collapse every run of non [a-z0-9] characters into a single hyphen separator and trim hyphens at both ends.
sections.edge_cases: Empty input returns an empty string; input of only separators (---) returns empty; repeated separators (a--b__c) collapse to one hyphen; leading or trailing punctuation is trimmed; german sharp s becomes ss; diacritics are stripped (Crème -> creme); non-latin characters such as 東京 are dropped; digits and dots (v2.0) become v2-0; non-string input throws TypeError.
